task: Replace the Restaurant conveyor's order-driven supply with an order-blind shuffled-bag food stream (src/minigames/restaurant/conveyor.js).
requirements: Keep the public API: createConveyor({ difficulty, foods, rng, ...overrides }) returning { advance(serviceDt, view?), take(dishId), nearestPickable(x, window), predictX(dishId, seconds), snapshot() }. `view` is still accepted and must be ignored: identical rng + dt sequence must produce an identical stream whatever view is passed.

Stream: a bag holding each entry of `foods` once, shuffled with the injected rng (Fisher-Yates). When empty, refill and reshuffle; if the new bag's first food equals the last food emitted and the bag has more than one food, swap it with another position so no food repeats across a bag seam.

Entry cadence in service time per difficulty: 1 → 4.0 s, 2 → 3.2 s, 3 → 2.6 s (overridable option `entryInterval`). The first dish enters 0.5 s after service starts, then one per interval, forever, regardless of orders. Dishes enter at entryX and move at the existing per-difficulty speed (0.9 / 1.05 / 1.2) and direction; a dish reaching exitX is removed with an `exit` event. No re-entry, no demand reconciliation, no filler logic, no visible cap.

Events stay { type: 'enter' | 'exit', dish }. For compatibility until the scene order lands, dish copies keep `filler: false` and snapshot keeps `pending: []`; everything else in snapshot stays (speed, direction, entryX, exitX, visibleHalfWidth, beltTravel, dishes, serviceTime).

Large dt must equal the same total of small dts (entries placed at their exact entry times, so a dish entering mid-step is positioned by its own elapsed travel). Zero, negative or non-finite dt changes nothing and samples no rng.
take(dishId) stays atomic: it removes the dish and returns a copy once; a second take of the same id returns null. Dishes outside visibleHalfWidth cannot be taken.

Tests in conveyor.test.mjs (replace the demand/filler tests): every 5 consecutive entries from a fresh bag contain all five foods; stream continues across 200+ entries; no same-food repeat across bag seams; maximum gap between two dishes of one food is at most 8 other dishes; view independence; entries continue with no orders; cadence per difficulty; large-dt equivalence; freeze on zero dt keeps every position; exit events; double take returns null.
constraints: Only src/minigames/restaurant/conveyor.js and src/minigames/restaurant/conveyor.test.mjs. Other orders are editing rival.js, claims.js, speech and minigame files in parallel — do not touch them.
Read SPEC.md §4 'Conveyor' and DESIGN_DECISIONS.md 2026-09-15 first; they are current.
Edit files with structured edits, never whole-file shell or regex rewrites.
